confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or price pages were checked. Argentina's high, volatile inflation and exchange-rate regime make July 2026 USD price levels uncertain (roughly ±30%), and accommodation is less certain than restaurant and beer anchors. Cocktail and wine glass were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about twice draught beer, wine glass about the same as beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-index copies of the RBA daily exchange-rates page and was not confirmed in an opened table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Meal and drink anchors follow Buenos Aires's own price tiers (neighborhood bodegones for inexpensive meals, mid-range dining in central tourist districts) and sit among large Latin American capitals with strong visitor demand. Accommodation is set to regional hostel and hotel levels.
